text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"multiple connected paragraphs with reasons and examples","quality":"organization","description":"The essay develops its points in a more coherent sequence instead of repeating the prompt."},{"evidence":"“because everyone get tired… do not make enought money… dont have enougt time”","quality":"idea development","description":"It gives several distinct reasons to support its position rather than offering mostly filler text."},{"evidence":"“If I am working and also going to school… I feel very extreced”","quality":"relevance of support","description":"Its example is tied to the argument and helps explain the writer’s point."},{"evidence":"“everyone need time to have and be with the family”","quality":"sentence variation","description":"It shows more independent sentence forms and varied clause structure than the other essay."},{"evidence":"“for these reason my school should not follow this model”","quality":"transitions","description":"It uses basic linking words to connect ideas and signal relationships between claims."}]}
